description: Browse the register: compact list of all published friction records, sorted by last-verified date (newest first). Filter by status and/or category.

locale.description: Output and citation language. English fallback when a current German translation is unavailable.

status.description: Optional status filter: "open" (problem exists), "mitigated" (reliable workaround), "fixed" (resolved and re-verified), "regressed" (was fixed, is back).

title: List friction records
